svg.title: The Iberian Peninsula
svg.desc: Situation map covering 10.0°W to 4.6°E, 35.6°N to 44.2°N. A reference plate: relief, the great rivers, and the Meseta. Natural Earth physical geography; no thematic layer. Natural Earth 1:50m physical and cultural vectors; SRTM-derived shaded relief.
